title: Pointwise Wave--Damping for Linearized Vlasov--Poisson: Compactly Supported Radial Equilibria and Relativistic Applications
summary: We establish weighted pointwise estimates for the response Green function and the complete electric field of the linearized Vlasov--Poisson system in $\mathbb{R}_x^3\times\mathbb{R}_v^3$ around compactly supported radial equilibria. Both decompose into a dispersive wave component with $t^{-3/2}$ decay in $L_x^\infty$ and a faster-decaying Landau-damped component. The wave estimate includes the survival threshold, where the oscillatory branch meets the continuous spectrum, while the damped estimates resolve the spatial fronts associated with the velocity boundaries.
